```{ojs}
// Access Tabulator globally loaded from <head>
Tabulator = window.Tabulator
```

```{ojs}
// Mock Outlier Data
raw_data = [
  { id: 1, community: "Utqiaġvik", date: "2026-01-15", kwh_rate: 1.42, status: "Flagged", override: "", is_outlier: true },
  { id: 2, community: "Bethel",    date: "2026-02-15", kwh_rate: 0.65, status: "Keep",    override: "", is_outlier: false },
  { id: 3, community: "Kotzebue",  date: "2026-03-15", kwh_rate: 2.89, status: "Flagged", override: "", is_outlier: true }
]
```

## Outlier Visualizer

```{ojs}
viewof selectedCommunity = Inputs.select(
  ["All", ...new Set(raw_data.map(d => d.community))],
  { label: "Community:" }
)

filteredData = raw_data.filter(d =>
  selectedCommunity === "All" || d.community === selectedCommunity
)

Plot.plot({
  height: 250,
  grid: true,
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(filteredData, {
      x: "date",
      y: "kwh_rate",
      stroke: d => d.is_outlier ? "red" : "green",
      r: 6,
      tip: true
    })
  ]
})
```

---

## Decision Table

```{ojs}
tableContainer = {
  const container = html`<div style="margin-bottom: 20px;"></div>`;

  const table = new Tabulator(container, {
    data: filteredData,
    layout: "fitColumns",
    columns: [
      { title: "Community", field: "community" },
      { title: "Date", field: "date" },
      { title: "Rate ($)", field: "kwh_rate" },
      {
        title: "Decision",
        field: "status",
        editor: "list",
        editorParams: { values: ["Keep", "Flag Invalid", "Override"] }
      },
      {
        title: "Override Rate",
        field: "override",
        editor: "input"
      }
    ]
  });

  window.currentTable = table;
  return container;
}
```
